authorization: User requested SemanticOPT proposals in batches of 50
resume: completed proposals use completed_count // 50 rounds and completed_count % 50 offset; a partial round requests only its remaining slots
feedback: all configurations in a batch are proposed before any batch measurement is observed
validation: every item is validated and deduplicated against initial observations, committed observations, and earlier items in the batch
fallback: existing constrained random fallback fills missing valid items and is labelled random_fallback
response_format: one numbered JSON object; peptide values are sequence strings and query values are integer plan arrays; converted losslessly to canonical configuration objects
